newsitem.title: USA: Ecuador convertibility to speed reform-de la Torre.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador convertibility to speed reform-de la Torre.

text.p: Ecuador's convertibility plan announced on Sunday will help to quicken the pace of reforms, said Augusto de la Torre, manager of Ecuador's Central Bank.
"I think convertibility should act as a short cut to accelerate the pace of reforms," Augusto de la Torre told Reuters Financial Television (RFTV) in an exclusive interview Monday.

Ecuador's de la Torre said although convertibility alone cannot deliver all the benefits of economic prosperity, it will impose a number of fiscal disciplines and therefore will help speed up the reform process.

Asked whether the plan is likely to get through Congress, de la Torre replied: "My own prediction is that the government will be able to mobilize the Congressional support to pass a number of reforms that are going to be sent because, as I mentioned, convertibility is (only) one piece."
De la Torre said some of the reforms will include strategic sectors such as petroleum, electricity and mining.
